candidates.change_summary: Change first if condition to check _BASE_RESERVE_ > _BASE_TARGET_ instead of _BASE_RESERVE_ < _BASE_TARGET_, so _BASE_TARGET_ is updated when reserve exceeds target rather than when below it.
Change second if condition to check _QUOTE_RESERVE_>_QUOTE_TARGET_ instead of _QUOTE_RESERVE_<_QUOTE_TARGET_, so _BASE_TARGET_ is updated when quote reserve exceeds target rather than when below it.
Combine both conditions to always reset to ONE and update targets unconditionally (remove reserve comparisons), so calling correctRState always sets _BASE_TARGET_ to _BASE_RESERVE_.
Only update _BASE_TARGET_ when BELOW_ONE, but set it to previous _BASE_TARGET_ + _BASE_RESERVE_ (accumulate) instead of setting equal, changing final value.
